description: You are a museum registrar at the Hartwell Center for American Art. Create a formal exhibition catalog for 'Light in Motion: Masterworks of French Impressionism'. Read the exhibition data from '/home/ga/Documents/exhibition_data.json' which contains venue details, curator foreword, and 8 artwork entries. Using Apache OpenOffice Writer, create a document saved as '/home/ga/Documents/Light_in_Motion_Catalog.odt'. The document must include: (1) A title page/section, (2) The Curator's Foreword, (3) Exhibition Overview, (4) Catalog Entries for all 8 artworks (using Heading 2 for each artwork title), (5) A Loan Acknowledgments section, and (6) An Inventory Checklist table. You must use Heading 1 styles for main sections, Heading 2 styles for artwork entries, include an auto-generated Table of Contents at the start, and add page numbers to the footer.
